pages.text: $(thing)Crop will not grow:$() make sure it is planted on farmland and has raw brightness 9 or higher. If it grows but quality is poor, use Spectacles and compare the variety's biome/light/temperature preferences.

$(thing)Drying Rack says Processing Paused:$() none of the four curing methods is currently valid. Check rain first, then the requirements of the cure you intended. Sneak-right-click the rack or wear Spectacles to confirm its current method/status.
pages.title: Rack Paused

pages.text: $(thing)Barrel stays Idle:$() fermentation needs Warmth ≥3 plus internal Barrel Humidity ≥25; aging needs Warmth ≤0, environmental Humidity 1–3, no sky, and block light ≤7. Adding tobacco resets current progress.
pages.title: Barrel Idle

pages.text: $(thing)Hookah will not light:$() load valid fuel, Shisha Tobacco, and a Water Potion or Dirty Hookah Water. If you want to smoke from it, also hold a Hookah Hose. Fuel is not the same as shisha durability; both must remain available.
pages.title: Hookah

pages.text: $(thing)Two tobacco stacks will not merge:$() their hidden quality/cure/cut/aging/label components may differ. Use averaging for compatible raw/cured/single-variety loose tobacco, a Tobacco Box for one exact batch, or a Tobacco Crate to package nine same-item units without averaging their metadata.
pages.title: Stacking

pages.text: $(thing)Spectacles show nothing:$() equip them in the vanilla head slot, or in Curios Head if Curios is installed, then look directly at a supported tobacco crop/processing block such as a Drying Rack, hanging tobacco bunch, Tobacco Barrel, or Production Monitor with no other GUI open.
pages.title: Spectacles
